Entries.Text: FX Reloader
The FX Reloader works with Dark Souls III, Sekiro, Elden Ring, Armored Core VI and Elden Ring Nightreign.
Connects to the running game: reloads the selected effect in the game from this editor's copy, and lists the effects the game has loaded. The game must run offline with EAC disabled.

Auto Refresh

every %.1f s

How often the game is read while this tool is shown, from {0} to {1} seconds. Shorter catches brief effects in Recently Detected; each read walks the game's whole effect list (about 9,000 effects), so very short intervals cost more CPU. The last read took {2} ms. Ctrl+click to type a value.

Reads the game's loaded effects now.
Disconnect
Disconnects from the game (for every reloader) and turns Auto Refresh off.

Restart weapon and SpEffect effects after a reload

After a reload, effects that weapons (buffs, infusions) and SpEffects (auras, status effects) play are switched off in the game's params for a moment and back on, so the game spawns them again with the reloaded version. The project's params aren't changed. Skipped when the world is reloaded afterwards.
